notes.title: Victory Banner — Discover a New WWII Real-Time Strategy
notes.content:
Hello, friends! 

[b]Victory Banner[/b] is a dynamic real-time strategy game featuring direct control of any unit — from infantry soldiers to armored vehicles. The first missions of the game explore key events of the early stage of World War II.

Prepare for intense battles, engaging missions, and deeply strategic and tactical gameplay.

[previewyoutube=5G9Kk7GKK8A;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Key Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Two gameplay modes: classic RTS and third-person direct control;
[*] Diverse units and vehicles: infantry, machine guns, mortars, tanks, and more;
[*] Interactive environments: build fortifications, use buildings and cover to complete objectives;
[*] Unique missions: from front-line engagements to covert operations behind enemy lines;
[*] Aiming mechanics for sniper rifles, tanks, mortars, and other types of weaponry.
[*] Air support and artillery strikes to help turn the tide in critical moments.
[/list]
Every action you take can directly influence the outcome of the battle.

Victory Banner is more than a strategy game about achieving objectives at any cost — it’s a story of ordinary people caught in a global conflict, of their courage, resolve, and ability to act when everything is at stake.

Follow the game page, add Victory Banner to your Wishlist, and let us know in the comments what you think of the trailer.

With faith in victory,
The Victory Banner Team
